title: Early Feasibility Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of the RenewalNail™ Plasma Treatment System in Patients With Mild to Moderate Onychomycosis (Fungal Nail)
brief_summary: Early feasibility study to determine if a three-treatment protocol with the RenewalNail™ plasma treatment system over a week will result in mycological cure and/or clear nail growth on the treated hallux toe.
